game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Dragon Hoard Cave Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Dragon Hoard Cave, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round, rock golems strike the crystal door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the crystal door from rock golems in Dragon Hoard Cave: keep the belt_count meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: belt_count drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
